Job Title: Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Sales Department OFS- Sales Location East India(Orissa/Jharsuguda/Kolkata) Reporting To Zonal Sales leader Job Summary The Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Sales will undergo structured training to develop technical and commercial competencies required for a successful career in industrial sales. The role involves learning product applications, understanding customer requirements, supporting sales activities, and contributing to business growth through customer engagement and market development initiatives. Key Responsibilities Sales Support & Customer Engagement Assist the sales team in identifying and pursuing new business opportunities. Visit customers along with senior sales professionals to understand market requirements and customer expectations. Support preparation of quotations, proposals, and tender documents. Follow up on customer inquiries and coordinate with internal teams for timely responses. Maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers. job.sourceDescription:
Description
Job Title: Human Resources Associate- Apprentice Location: DLF Cyber Hub, Gurugram About the Program The Eptura Apprenticeship Program is designed to provide recent graduates and early-career professionals with meaningful, hands-on experience within a global SaaS organization. Throughout this 12-month program, apprentices will receive mentoring, structured learning opportunities, and exposure to commercial operations and sales processes. Eligibility To be considered for this apprenticeship, candidates must: Have completed a Bachelor's degree within the past two years Have no more than two years of professional work experience Be legally eligible to participate in an apprenticeship program in India Shape the Future of Work with Eptura At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Our innovative worktech solutions empower 25 million users across 115 countries to thrive in a digitally connected world. Trusted by 45% of Fortune 500 companies, we're redefining workplace innovation and driving success for organizations around the globe. Role Overview As an AI Marketing Apprentice, you will work alongside our marketing, product marketing, and sales teams to help build the next generation of AI-powered marketing. You'll learn how to create and train AI agents, automate repetitive marketing tasks, generate personalized content, produce videos, and support sales teams with customized customer presentations. This role is designed for an early-career professional, recent graduate, or career starter who wants hands-on experience at the intersection of marketing, AI, automation, and content creation.

Responsibilities
Build and test AI agents using Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio. Train AI agents using approved product messaging, sales content, customer insights, and brand guidelines. Assist in creating social media posts, blogs, emails, and campaign content using AI tools. Develop customized sales presentations tailored to specific customers, industries, and buyer personas. Produce short-form and long-form videos for social media, product launches, webinars, and internal communications. Create brand-compliant images, graphics, animations, and multimedia assets using generative AI tools. Research competitors, market trends, and customer needs using AI-powered analytics. Assist in creating executive presentations, thought leadership content, and customer-facing materials. Analyze campaign, website, and social media performance and generate actionable insights. Test and improve AI-generated content for accuracy, quality, and brand consistency. Support sales and marketing teams by creating enablement content, battlecards, and customer communications. Build and maintain knowledge libraries that improve AI agent performance over time. Experiment with new AI tools, prompting techniques, and automation approaches. Partner with marketing, product, sales, and customer success teams to identify opportunities for AI-driven efficiency. Present recommendations, findings, and AI project outcomes to marketing leadership. Stay current on emerging AI technologies, content creation trends, and Microsoft Copilot capabilities. Within your first year, you will: Build and improve AI agents for marketing and sales teams. Create content that is actively used across campaigns and customer engagements. Produce engaging social and video content. Help automate repeatable marketing workflows. Develop expertise in Microsoft's AI ecosystem. Build a portfolio of real-world AI, marketing, and content creation projects

About You
We're looking for a motivated self-starter who is keen to build a career in marketing or technology. The following will set you up for success in this role: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English High attention to detail and a methodical approach to organizing information. Strong interest in AI, marketing technology, and automation. Comfortable learning new technologies and software platforms. Demonstrated interest in content creation, social media, video production, or digital marketing. Experience using Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 applications. Experience creating social media, video, or digital content. Basic video editing experience using Canva, Adobe Express, Clipchamp, Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar tools. Experience with PowerPoint and visual storytelling. Portfolio of content, videos, presentations, or creative projects.

Benefits
Monthly stipend of 21,000 INR Health Insurance fully paid – Self 13 Public Holidays Paid Time off Hybrid and Remote working Exposure to the latest trends and technologies in the SaaS industry. Mentorship from global experienced professionals in the marketing, sales, renewals and customer success fields. Potential for career advancement based on performance and dedication. Eptura Information: Follow us on Twitter | LinkedIn | Facebook | YouTube At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business. After the Apprenticeship The apprenticeship is a 12-month development program . Successful completion does not guarantee permanent employment; however, apprentices may be considered for future opportunities based on performance, business needs, and the availability of approved positions.

job.description:
Who we are

About Stripe
Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses (https://stripe.com/customers) build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth.

The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety.

When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate.

We make upgrades to our products (https://stripe.com/roadmap) every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs (https://status.stripe.com/) on the internet. We build entirely new pieces (https://tempo.xyz/) of financial (https://mpp.dev/) infrastructure (https://joinopenstandard.com/) to enable new ideas.

And our significant advances in risk and fraud (https://stripe.com/radar) infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 


Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.


Your role



Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.


To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.


Who you are






Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.






Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 






Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities.  At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.






Minimum requirements






A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience).






Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.






Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).






Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.






Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.






Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.






Preferred qualifications






One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge.  Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems. Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases. Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers. Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.

job.sourceDescription:
Job Description Summary

This role involves designing and developing embedded software (Control/Firmware) and software tools for X-ray generators within the Imaging Sub Systems group at GE HealthCare. The position requires knowledge of Embedded C, C++, and basic programming concepts, along with an understanding of digital electronics and schematics involving MCU/DSP-based systems. Candidates should be familiar with MATLAB and Simulink for control application development and simulation, and should have experience using Git. The role focuses on embedded software development, control applications, and HW integration.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain embedded software (Control/Firmware) for X-ray generators within the Imaging Sub Systems group.
  • Develop software tools required for configuration, testing, validation, and support of embedded systems.
  • Implement software solutions using Embedded C, C++, and C programming languages for real-time embedded applications.
  • Develop and simulate control applications using MATLAB and Simulink.
  • Integrate and troubleshoot hardware drivers and support software-hardware interfacing activities.
  • Work on Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS)
  • Support the development and implementation of control algorithms, including PI/PID-based control loops.
  • Analyze and evaluate control system performance using tools and techniques such as Bode plots, Nyquist plots, and margin analysis.
  • Work with digital hardware platforms involving MCUs, DSPs, and SoC devices (Xilinx/Intel).

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's/Master’s degree with Electronics/Electrical/Control Engineering or equivalent.
  • Recent graduate or up to 1 year of relevant internship or experience.
  • Knowledge of embedded software development and embedded system
  • Programming experience in Embedded C, C++, and other C programming languages for real-time embedded applications..
  • Knowledge of MATLAB and Simulink for control application development and simulation.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Desired Characteristics

  • Internship or relevant experience in Embedded
  • Knowledge of embedded software development and embedded system
  • Knowledge of MATLAB and Simulink for control application development and simulation.
  • Experience in programming with C language and assembly language.
  • Knowledge on control loops like PI/PID etc
  • Basic understanding of control system analysis and margin analysis. Nyquist plots, Bode plots, etc.
  • Basic understanding of digital schematics (MCU/DSP etc).
  • Exposure to SoC devices (Xilinx/Intel) and experience in using Git.

Inclusion and Diversity


GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.


We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.


Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.


Disclaimer: GE HealthCare will never ask for payment to process documents, refer you to a third party to process applications or visas, or ask you to pay costs. Never send money to anyone suggesting they can provide employment with GE HealthCare.



Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No
